title: Progressive Doodle · Pair relay
hook: Find a game, gather your friends and start playing.

knows: The group wants an activity to play together.
doesNotKnow: The setup, turn and ending for this house-rule format.

misconception: The group has to know a complicated rulebook before starting.
objective: Learn how to play Progressive Doodle · Pair relay with friends.

claims.text: Original house rules: Choose a familiar animal or object. The lead adds one feature at a time to a drawing, pausing after each feature for guesses. The others guess before five features have been added. Form pairs. On each pair’s turn, both people make separate attempts with fresh challenges, helping only their partner. The pair earns one point only if both succeed. Each pair has two turns. Highest score wins.
claims.source: Original playable house-rule proposal; not an authoritative ruleset for a traditional game.

claims.text: For this version: 4, 6 or 8 players; materials: Paper and pencil.
claims.source: Proposed setup and player range for this activity.

recall.question: In Progressive Doodle, what counts as a successful turn?
options: The others guess before five features have been added.
The lead skips the turn without attempting it.
The group ends the round before anyone plays.
recall.why: The others guess before five features have been added.
